command:base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main); oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/ and the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no new dependency - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

findings.message: Traceability: packages/client/src/test/features/locations/steps/locations_persistence.steps.ts and locations_ui_unit.steps.tsx have no `// @add-locations-via-search @FR-X` comment before any f.Scenario. .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md rule 5: 'Tag comment — before `f.Scenario` add comment `// @<change-name> @FR-X`'; tasks.md preamble: 'Every new test, step file and feature carries add-locations-via-search traceability (... `// @add-locations-via-search @FR-X` before `f.Scenario` ...)'. locations_persistence.feature also lacks the 'Implements change add-locations-via-search.' description line that gherkin.md's Structure section prescribes (locations_ui_unit.feature has it).

Module boundary: src/test/writeSchedulers.ts:1 imports `WriteScheduler` from '@/controller/writeScheduler' although controller/index.ts exports it (`export type { WriteScheduler } from './writeScheduler'`). process-invariants.md: 'Import only through `index.ts` of a module. Never import from internal files of a sibling module.'

File size: src/adapters/localStorageLocationRepository.test.ts (401 lines) and src/controller/useLocations.test.tsx (354 lines) exceed the hard cap. process-invariants.md: 'Target 100–200 lines per file; 300 is a hard cap'; CLAUDE.md: 'Files must stay under 200 lines'. Also over 200: zoneCitiesSource.test.ts (250), locations_ui_unit.steps.tsx (248), LocationSearchDialog.test.tsx (246), locations_persistence.steps.ts (222), createCompositeCitySearch.test.ts (206), locations_view_contract_e2e.steps.ts (203).

Values defined twice: src/adapters/city-search/zoneCitiesSource.ts:21 `const LANGUAGES = ['en', 'ru'] as const` copies SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES from src/i18n.ts; `REGION_DISPLAY_TYPE = 'region'` is defined in both zoneCitiesSource.ts:20 and presenter/countryName.ts:3; `UTC_ZONE_ID = 'UTC'` (zoneCitiesSource.ts:18) repeats the 'UTC' literal of POPULAR_TIME_ZONE_IDS in constants/search.ts. code-style.md self-check: 'Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant' (use the shared constant, e.g. SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, and put shared values in src/constants/).

Traceability gaps: src/model/store.ts cites only 'Implements D3 of add-locations-via-search' (a design decision, not a proposal requirement ID); src/controller/locationsContext.ts has no requirement reference; src/app/ViewHost.tsx gained `data-view-id` for this change (task 8.5, D12) but its JSDoc still names only add-main-page-scaffold. traceability.md: 'Every artifact must be traceable to a requirement ID from proposal.md.'

findings.message: Repeated string literal breaks the no-hardcoded-values rule. `.claude/rules/code-style.md` says: "Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant". The `Intl.DisplayNames` option `fallback: "none"` is written as a literal in two new files: `packages/client/src/adapters/city-search/zoneCitiesSource.ts:92` and `packages/client/src/presenter/countryName.ts:11`. The `type` option in the same object was already moved to `REGION_DISPLAY_TYPE` in `constants/search.ts`. Add a matching constant (for example `REGION_DISPLAY_FALLBACK = "none"`) in `constants/search.ts`, export it through `constants/index.ts`, and use it in both files.
